dog.description_text:
Pongo

❤️ PONGO IS READY TO FIND HIS FOREVER PEOPLE! ❤️
How is this sweet boy still waiting?!
Pongo is an adorable 3-month-old Terrier mix—and when we say “mix,” your guess is as good as ours. 😂 His DNA may be a mystery, but his personality definitely isn't!
This little guy is a PEOPLE LOVER at heart. 🥹❤️
He loves being close to his humans, soaking up all the attention and cuddling like it's his full-time job.
But don't let the cuddle bug fool you…
PONGO PLAYS HARD! 😂💨🐾
dog.name: Pongo
